stories.title: Zeven jaar cel geëist tegen Jalal O. voor rol bij dodelijke explosie Schammenkamp

en.title: Seven years imprisonment demanded against Jalal O. for role in fatal Schammenkamp explosion
en.summary: Prosecutors have requested a seven-year prison sentence against Jalal O. for his alleged involvement in a deadly explosion at a drug laboratory in Rotterdam's Schammenkamp district in 2024, which killed three people.

stories.title: OM eist 7 jaar cel tegen Jalal O. voor dodelijke ontploffing Schammenkamp

en.title: Prosecutors demand 7 years imprisonment against Jalal O. for fatal Schammenkamp explosion
en.summary: Prosecutors have requested a seven-year sentence against 37-year-old Jalal O., the renter of a garage where a January 2024 explosion in Rotterdam killed three people and destroyed houses. He is suspected of cocaine production and the explosion itself.

stories.title: Oekraïne meldt vier doden na Russische aanvallen op industrieterreinen

en.title: Ukraine reports four deaths following Russian attacks on industrial sites
en.summary: Ukraine has reported four fatalities resulting from Russian attacks on industrial facilities.

stories.title: Auto rijdt 250 kilometer per uur, crasht en vat vlam bij McDonald's in Udenhout

en.title: Car traveling 250 kilometers per hour crashes and catches fire at McDonald's in Udenhout
en.summary: During a police pursuit, a vehicle left the road near a McDonald's in Udenhout and caught fire. The three occupants fled but were apprehended shortly after.

stories.title: Een dansende banaan, elkaar krabbelen: Hyves is terug

en.title: A dancing banana, scratching each other: Hyves is back
en.summary: Dutch social media platform Hyves, which was popular years ago, has relaunched after a 13-year absence.

stories.title: Doden in Oekraïne na Russische aanvallen, Oekraïne raakt oliecomplex

en.title: Deaths in Ukraine after Russian attacks, Ukraine's oil complex hit
en.summary: Russia conducted a major air assault on southeastern Ukraine, killing at least four people and damaging industrial facilities and an oil complex across multiple cities.

stories.title: Auto crasht bij McDonald's na achtervolging met 250 km per uur

en.title: Car crashes at McDonald's after chase at 250 km per hour
en.summary: A vehicle pursued by police at speeds around 250 kilometers per hour crashed and caught fire at a McDonald's location in the Netherlands, with three occupants fleeing the scene.

stories.title: Hyves is terug: krabbels, dansende bananen en geen verslavende algoritmes

en.title: Hyves is back: scratches, dancing bananas and no addictive algorithms
en.summary: Hyves social network has relaunched 22 years after its creation, offering features like fewer intrusive advertisements and non-addictive design compared to current platforms.

stories.title: Trump onverstaanbaar bij mediamoment, media blijven weg en tonen zich solidair met CNN

en.title: Trump unintelligible at media moment, media stay away and show solidarity with CNN
en.summary: President Trump opened a new helicopter landing site at the White House on Monday. Multiple media outlets were absent from the event and demonstrated support for CNN.

stories.title: Privacytoezichthouder: mensen filmen met camerabril mag vrijwel nooit

en.title: Privacy regulator: filming people with camera glasses is almost never permitted
en.summary: The Dutch Data Protection Authority warns that footage recorded with camera glasses cannot be freely used, shared, or published without consent. The authority recommends organizations prohibit camera glass usage.

stories.title: Ook Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens waarschuwt voor ‘gluurbrillen’: anderen filmen met camerabril is ‘vrijwel altijd verboden’

en.title: Data Protection Authority also warns against 'spy glasses': filming others with camera glasses is 'almost always forbidden'
en.summary: The Data Protection Authority has issued a warning that recording others with camera glasses is prohibited in nearly all circumstances.

stories.title: Jalal O. – verdacht van de dodelijke Schammenkamp-explosie – luistert naar de slachtofferverklaringen en zegt: ‘Zoiets gun je niemand’

en.title: Jalal O. – suspected in fatal Schammenkamp explosion – listens to victim statements and says: 'You wouldn't wish that on anyone'
en.summary: A 2024 explosion in Rotterdam's Zuidwijk destroyed part of an apartment building and killed three people. The owner of the business space where the explosion occurred maintains he had no knowledge of it.
